Matching records that name the same company or person across sources, by identifier first and by fuzzy evidence second.

The concept behind it: [Entity resolution](@/glossary/record-linkage.md).

Services that draw on it: [Corporate and counterparty due diligence](@/services/due-diligence.md), [Digital investigation and OSINT dossiers](@/services/digital-investigation.md), [Sanctions, PEP and beneficial-ownership screening](@/services/compliance-screening.md) and [Insolvency, litigation and register change monitoring](@/services/continuous-monitoring.md).

Practised with: [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md), [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md), [Dockerfile](@/glossary/dockerfile.md), [FastAPI](@/glossary/fastapi.md) and [Flowbite Pro](@/glossary/flowbite-pro.md).

It was applied in client work in Real-estate developer and Financial and investment group; the use cases below give the principle and the intent, without names or numbers.

How to read this page: the definition is the experience vocabulary's; the services, technologies, public [repositories](@/glossary/repository.md) and use cases are derived and each links to its page.
